about.heading:
Engineer at heart,
builder by craft.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer with a soft spot for the whole pipeline — designing schemas, shaping APIs, and sweating the last few pixels of an interface. I care less about which layer a problem lives in and more about shipping something that feels effortless to use.

Over the last few years I've built real-time collaboration tools, edge-deployed services, and developer platforms used by teams in production. I write code that's a joy to maintain, document the why, and stay calm when the pager goes off.

quotes.author: Vineet Sahu
quotes.text: I had the pleasure of working with Rishav Kumar at Mindifre Solutions, and he is an exceptional professional. Rishav consistently demonstrated strong technical skills, a keen problem-solving mindset, and an eagerness to take on new challenges. His ability to deliver high-quality work while meeting deadlines was always impressive. Rishav is a proactive team member who always collaborates effectively and brings innovative solutions to the table. His positive attitude and strong work ethic make him a pleasure to work with, and he adds great value to any team.

quotes.author: Sameer Kumar
quotes.text: We used to work back at Mindfire Solutions, I was mostly consumed with non technical stuff and lil bit of backend but rishav had my back for any of the UI reqs that crossed my deliverables. He invested his RoR skills heavily in some product USPs which later served as backbone of whole system. Although he was a fresher that time, he came par with many techs as IOT, RoR, React, Databases, etc. Totally hard working fella, 💯 points on that, twist him, stress him, he won't break and get work done on time. 🎖

quotes.author: Abhisek Kumar Singh
quotes.text: Rishav is an amazing person, who brings all of the skills and expertise in programming. Working with him is a rare opportunity to come across, a self-driven environmentalist with teamwork spirit. I hereby highly recommend him for efficient programming skills. I’m hoping he’ll deliver ever more to other workplaces as well.

quotes.author: Adarsh Mohanty
quotes.text: Rishav is one of the best among all people I have ever met and is a loyal colleague, understands complex matters. Rishav is a versatile, strong, and goal-oriented team player.

quotes.author: Nirmal Hota
quotes.text: Rishav has started his career from my team. I have seen him turning from a novice to a rock star. He picks up things quickly. I love his dedication.

quotes.author: JP Mohapatra
quotes.text: The dedication of this man is on another level. His multitasking skill makes him a good team player. It was a great experience working with him. Wish him a great learning experience ahead.
Rishav ships features that just work. He thinks in systems and writes code that's a genuine joy to maintain.
